snippet.title: GOALS Gameplay Trailer. No excuses, just football
snippet.description:
GOALS is a fast, responsive football game built for pure skill, real competition, and a global community. Gameplay first, free to play, crossplay and unique players. No excuses - just football.

Available now on PC (Steam and Epic), Xbox X|S and PS5

www.playgoals.com
